intent: The panel chrome for a modal: one shared header (tone icon + eyebrow, Close, h2 title, description) and footer (footerStart left, actions right). Modal, AlertDialog and the AppShell work panel render it; Drawer uses the same header and footer. Not a page Card.
useWhen: Showing modal sizes in the catalog without an overlay

role.note: Modal sets dialog. Leave the default when ModalCard is static.

tabIndex.note: Modal sets -1 so the dialog can take focus.

eyebrow.note: Short area name in the header row, 12px, like Billing · Invoices. Caller-provided.

tone.note: Tone icon (16px, aria-hidden) and status word from KitLabels (info, success, warning, danger) before the eyebrow, so status is never colour alone. neutral shows the eyebrow only.

size.note: Width sm 352 (22rem, 16 padding), md 448 (28rem, 24), lg 576 (36rem, 24). Radius 16 (surfaceLg) on every size.

onClose.note: Close only when provided: a 32px ghost neutral IconButton named Close (KitLabels close), on the right of the eyebrow row, or of the title row when there is no eyebrow.

footer.note: kit Buttons / ButtonGroup, size sm: Cancel, then one primary (or danger) last on the right.

footerStart.note: Left of the footer actions, first in the footer tab order: an Ask Button (appearance outline, mode neutral, size sm, iconStart MessageCircle) or a count like 6 of 6 selected. Labels are caller-provided.

requirements: Inside Modal: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, tabIndex=-1; inside AlertDialog: role=alertdialog, aria-modal=true, tabIndex=-1
Title is an h2 (18px, weight 550) and the accessible name via aria-labelledby
description (one sentence, 14px) is aria-describedby when present
Tone icon and the Close glyph are aria-hidden; the tone shows as a word too (Warning · Integrations)
Close is a kit IconButton named Close (KitLabels close), only when onClose is set
footerStart sits before the actions in the tab order
built-in labels (close, info, success, warning, danger) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent local ModalCard, Dialog, or DialogContent
Do not use Card, Scorecard, or InsightCard as modal chrome
Do not add a footer divider of your own: ModalCard draws one only while the body scrolls
Footer actions must be kit Buttons / ButtonGroup
Do not put more than one primary (or danger) Button in the footer
snippet: <ModalCard eyebrow="Billing · Invoices" title="Edit invoice INV-2042" description="Change the due date or the amount." footerStart={<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="sm" iconStart="MessageCircle">Ask about this</Button>} footer={<ButtonGroup ariaLabel="Modal actions"><Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="sm">Cancel</Button><Button appearance="solid" mode="primary" size="sm">Save changes</Button></ButtonGroup>}>...</ModalCard>
